title: Run manifest
description: Public adopter/synthetic-fixture contract: provenance and funnel counts for a single SOURCE -> GATE -> EVALUATE run: identifiers, model/prompt references, and per-stage counts, recorded so the run's aggregate accounting is checkable and its provenance pinned. Scope: prompt_commit is required here so ADOPTERS pin their own prompt source; the paper's private production provenance record is a separate format that pins rendered prompt artifacts by SHA-256 hashes. This manifest does not contain candidate inputs, per-card decisions, or the engine — reproducing or auditing individual decisions requires those artifacts. Pairs with the ledger, which holds the admitted hypotheses.

model.description: Exact model identifier(s) used per stage (logged per run for reproducibility).

prompt_commit.description: Pin of the prompt bundle used for this run. For adopters: the Git commit of your prompts source (e.g. your prompts.md). For the paper's production runs this field was not used: exact production prompts are pinned by sha256 artifact hashes in the private run record, with the public src/prompts.md as their sanitized reference.

funnel.description: Counts at each stage of the cheap-source -> deterministic-gate -> expensive-evaluate funnel.

admission_rate.description: admitted / sourced; the headline restraint metric.

ledger.description: Path of the ledger the admitted hypotheses were written to.
